<transform sourceClass='EnsLib.HL7.Message' targetClass='EnsLib.HL7.Message' sourceDocType='CernAdtHl7:CernerInAdt' targetDocType='CernAdtHl7:CernerInAdt' create='new' language='objectscript' > <annotation>Sets "Y" to ZXY if it's a test patient otherwise sets it to "N"</annotation> <assign value='source' property='target' action='set' /> <assign value='"1"' property='target.{ZXY:ID}' action='set' /> <if condition='context.isTestFacility ="1"' > <true> <assign value='"Y"' property='target.{ZXY:ProdTestFlag}' action='set' /> </true> <false> <assign value='"N"' property='target.{ZXY:ProdTestFlag}' action='set' /> </false> </if>
</transform>
